title: Prime Minister meets Mrs. Akie Abe, wife of late former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi met Mrs. Akie Abe, wife of late former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe in New Delhi today and expressed deep appreciation for her enduring association with India.
The Prime Minister recalled Shinzo Abe as a dear friend and visionary leader who played a defining role in elevating India-Japan relations to new heights.
Shri Modi said that the inauguration of the Abe Memorial Corridor at the Rudraksh Convention Centre in Varanasi was a fitting tribute to Shinzo Abe’s lasting contribution to India-Japan friendship.
In a post on X, Shri Modi said;
“Pleased to meet Mrs. Akie Abe, wife of late former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe. Deeply value her enduring association with India.
Abe San was a dear friend and a visionary leader who played a defining role in elevating India-Japan relations to new heights. The inauguration of the Abe Memorial Corridor at the Rudraksh Convention Centre in Varanasi yesterday is a fitting tribute to his lasting contribution to India-Japan friendship.

故安倍晋三元首相の昭恵夫人とお会いでき、嬉しく思います。長年にわたるインドとの深いご縁を心より大切にしております。

安倍さんは親愛なる友人であり、インドと日本の関係を新たな高みへと導いた先見性あるリーダーでした。昨日ヴァラナシのルドラクシュ・コンベンション・センターに「安倍メモリアル・コリドー」が開設されたことは、印日友好関係の発展に対する安倍首相の多大な功績を称えるふさわしい記念となりました。
